strings.app.name: Sunfold
strings.disclaimer.askFirst.body: Please speak to a healthcare professional before fasting if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, living with diabetes or taking medication that affects blood sugar, taking any medicine that must be taken with food, underweight, or living with a chronic condition.
strings.disclaimer.askFirst.title: Talk to a doctor first
strings.disclaimer.eatingDisorders.body: If you have or have had an eating disorder, or if tracking meals makes you anxious, a fasting app can make things worse. Please talk to a doctor or a support service where you live before using Sunfold.
strings.disclaimer.eatingDisorders.title: If food is difficult
strings.disclaimer.heading: Sunfold is a timer, not a doctor
strings.disclaimer.lede: Sunfold tracks when you eat. It cannot know anything about your health, and it does not diagnose, treat or advise.
strings.disclaimer.notMedical.body: Everything in Sunfold, including the metabolic phases, is general educational information. It is not a diagnosis, a treatment plan, or a recommendation for you personally.
strings.disclaimer.notMedical.title: Not medical advice
strings.disclaimer.phases.body: The hours shown for each metabolic phase are approximations from general research. What actually happens depends on your last meal, your activity, your sleep and your body. Treat them as a rough map, not a measurement.
strings.disclaimer.phases.title: About the phases
strings.disclaimer.stop.body: Dizziness, faintness, confusion, a racing heart or unusual weakness are reasons to eat and to seek medical help. No streak is worth it.
strings.disclaimer.stop.title: Stop if you feel unwell
strings.disclaimer.title: Health notice

Please talk to a doctor before fasting if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, living with diabetes or taking medication that affects blood sugar, taking any medicine that must be taken with food, underweight, or living with a chronic condition.

strings.phase.autophagy.detail: Most of what is known comes from animal studies. Human research is still limited, and there is no way to measure it from a phone.
strings.phase.autophagy.summary: Cellular recycling is thought to increase during longer fasts.
strings.phase.autophagy.title: Autophagy
strings.phase.early.detail: Glycogen — glucose stored in the liver and muscles — usually covers energy needs through this window.
strings.phase.early.summary: Insulin falls and the liver begins releasing stored glucose.
strings.phase.early.title: Early fasting
strings.phase.fat.detail: The shift is gradual rather than a switch, and how quickly it happens varies a great deal between people.
strings.phase.fat.summary: Glycogen runs low and the body turns more towards fat for fuel.
strings.phase.fat.title: Fat burning
strings.phase.fed.detail: Blood sugar and insulin typically rise after eating, and energy comes from the meal rather than from stores.
strings.phase.fed.summary: Your body is digesting the last meal and running on it.
strings.phase.fed.title: Fed state
strings.phase.ketosis.detail: Some people report steadier energy and less hunger here; others notice nothing in particular. Both are normal.
strings.phase.ketosis.summary: The liver produces ketones from fat, which the brain can use as fuel.
strings.phase.ketosis.title: Ketosis
strings.phases.disclaimer: These hours are approximations drawn from general research. What actually happens depends on your last meal, your activity and your body. This is educational information, not medical advice.
strings.phases.title: Metabolic phases
strings.privacy.changes.body: If this policy changes, the updated version appears here and in the app itself.
strings.privacy.changes.title: Changes
strings.privacy.children.body: Sunfold is not directed at children and is not intended for anyone under 18 without medical supervision.
strings.privacy.children.title: Children
strings.privacy.deletion.body: Settings → Delete all data removes every fast, weight entry and note immediately. Deleting the app removes everything else.
strings.privacy.deletion.title: Deleting your data
strings.privacy.heading: Your data stays on your phone
strings.privacy.health.body: Sunfold does not read from or write to Apple Health.
strings.privacy.health.title: Apple Health
strings.privacy.lede: Sunfold has no account, no server and no analytics. Everything you record lives on your device.
strings.privacy.notCollected.body: No account, no email address, no advertising identifiers, no analytics or tracking SDKs, no location. Nothing you record is sent anywhere, because Sunfold has no server to send it to.
strings.privacy.notCollected.title: What Sunfold does not collect
strings.privacy.notifications.body: All reminders are scheduled locally by your iPhone. Sunfold has no push server, and notification content never leaves your device.
strings.privacy.notifications.title: Notifications
strings.privacy.purchases.body: Purchases are processed by Apple. To check whether Sunfold Pro is active, the app uses RevenueCat, which receives a randomly generated app user ID and your App Store receipt. It never receives your name, your email, or anything you record in Sunfold.
strings.privacy.purchases.title: Purchases
strings.privacy.stored.body: Your fasts, weight entries, notes and settings are saved on this device. If you have iPhone backups switched on, they are included in your own backup, which only you can open.
strings.privacy.stored.title: What Sunfold stores
strings.privacy.title: Privacy
strings.protocol.16_8.blurb: The usual place to start — for most people that means a later breakfast or an earlier dinner.
strings.protocol.16_8.subtitle: 16 h fasting · 8 h eating
strings.protocol.18_6.blurb: A step up from 16:8, once that has become routine.
strings.protocol.18_6.subtitle: 18 h fasting · 6 h eating
strings.protocol.20_4.blurb: One long fast and a short window. Demanding — worth easing into.
strings.protocol.20_4.subtitle: 20 h fasting · 4 h eating
strings.protocol.5_2.blurb: Two longer fasts a week, eating normally on the other days.
strings.protocol.5_2.subtitle: 24 h fasting · twice a week
strings.protocol.custom.blurb: Anything from 4 to 48 hours, in half-hour steps.
strings.protocol.custom.subtitle: Set your own length
strings.protocol.custom.title: Custom
strings.protocols.custom.longNotice: Fasts of 24 hours or more are worth discussing with a doctor first.
strings.protocols.disclaimer: No schedule suits everyone. Pick the one that fits your day, and talk to a doctor if you are unsure.
